name: online-assessment-platform
description: Secure online MCQ + coding assessment platform with proctoring and a real code judge.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run prisma:push && npm --prefix backend run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
